title: Windward Science platform onramp jotter
content:
Quick raw notes from intake call + initial technical capture (very rough).

Attendees: Windward Science — Alex (CTO), Dr. Mei Chen (ML eng lead), Priya Shah (Redwood SE), Marco Alvarez (Redwood solutions).
Call date: 2025-01-14. Follow-up sync: planned 2025-01-28.

What Windward does (one-liner capture): small biotech org running internal research pipelines, stores experiment notes & assay PDFs in an internal data lake (S3-like), high compliance needs (HIPAA-adj / regulated PII-ish experimental identifiers). Primary user workloads: conversational retrieval over docs for scientists + short summarization of assay results + embeddings-based nearest-neighbor search for prior experiments.

Primary ask / success criteria:
- Secure private onramp: want Redwood Private (VPC) or air-gapped VM option. No data may leave their VPC unencrypted.
- Latency goal: interactive assistant p95 ~< 250ms for short prompts (<= 256 tokens) when hitting the dedicated pool.
- Cost sensitivity: prototyping budget limited, pilot should show token-cost delta vs their current hosted provider.
- Output quality: must preserve entity names and numeric assay values reliably (few false-normalizations).

Initial technical constraints and notes:
- Data location: S3-compatible internal endpoint, requires VPC peering and IAM role mapping. They use HashiCorp Vault + AWS KMS; will require KMS integration or bring-your-own-key (BYOK) plan.
- Network: private subnets only, no outbound internet from compute nodes. Control plane in Redwood-PaaS may be allowed to talk to mgmt plane over approved egress IPs — confirm.
- Models: prefer open-source model stack. Suggested candidates from convo: 7B/13B instruction-tuned LLM (they called out wanting low hallucination on numeric data). Ask: test both quantized 13B (int8) and 7B float16 on dedicated instance types (A100-80GB equiv).
- Tokenization: many assay IDs are alphanumeric, watch for subword splits causing normalization errors (example: "ABC-21-7b" -> split into tokens that LM normalizes). Will need prompt engineering and possible post-filtering.
- KV cache behaviour: interactive sessions with long context; scientists paste 6–10 short docs (avg 2k tokens) then ask questions. Consider prefix caching + segmenting per-document to avoid re-encoding.

Gotchas surfaced (quick):
- Regulatory: they asked about audit logs for model inputs/outputs — must map to Redwood Console retention SLAs + optional event export to their SIEM (Splunk).
- No direct internet from compute means any model downloads/quantization must be pre-baked in deployment image or staged via approved S3.
- Exact numeric preservation: models sometimes output approximate numbers; propose: post-hoc numeric verifier step (regex check + fallback to exact quoting from doc).
- Throughput vs latency: their expected concurrency is low (2–6 concurrent scientists), but some experiments trigger batch scraping of 120 docs (cold start heavy). Need to tune autoscale/burst policy to handle spikes without violating private-network constraints.

Quick sketch of pilot plan (2–4 weeks):
1) Week 0–1: onboarding checklist - VPC peering request (network team ticket), KMS key exchange, sample data slice export (10 doc types, sanitized), define test prompts.
2) Week 1–2: provision private deployment with two model variants (7B fp16, 13B int8). Preload models into image stored in their S3. Validate model start-up with no outbound internet.
3) Week 2–3: run quality evaluation on prompt set (20 canonical queries + 30 numeric-check cases). Capture token cost + latency metrics in Console (export sample trace).
4) Week 3–4: iterate on prompt templates, deploy caching config (prefix + document sharding), finalize rollout plan if meets p95 latency and numeric QC thresholds.

Immediate action items (for SE team):
- [Priya] Create network request template for Windward net team (include CIDR ranges, ports, expected egress endpoints) -> due 2025-01-17. Link to JIRA-OPS-1369.
- [Marco] Draft image build steps for preloading quantized models into their S3 artifact repo (document constraints for no-internet compute) -> due 2025-01-20.
- [Jenna] Prepare prompt set (20 queries + 30 numeric edge cases) and rubric for evaluation.
- [Alex/Windward] Provide 10-sample-doc sanitized export (by 2025-01-18) or sign NDA to allow unsanitized sample.

Open questions to resolve (short list):
- Can Windward accept Redwood control plane calls for telemetry, or do they require fully air-gapped control plane? (affects rollout speed).
- KMS: will they permit Redwood-managed integration (via cross-account kms grants) or require HSM/BYOK onboard?
- Model size: are they open to a staged approach (start 7B float16, swap-in 13B int8 if quality/latency tradeoffs justify)? They showed preference for smaller footprint but higher numeric fidelity.
- SLA: do they need guaranteed p99 latencies or just p95 for initial pilot? They said p95 target; escalate if p99 required.

Prompt / evaluation notes (raw):
- Example problematic prompt: "Summarize experiment 2024-11-A7: glucose uptake increased from 0.45 to .5mg/ml; are these replicates?" -> watch for unit normalization and decimal rounding.
- Idea: create a post-processing layer that detects numeric sequences and forces exact echo when answer references a doc-sourced number.

Risk register (short):
- Risk: model hallucination of assay values -> Mit: numeric verifier + quoted source snippets, increase temperature = 0.0 for numeric-critical flows.
- Risk: network blocking model bootstrap -> Mit: pre-bake images + staging S3 instructions + checklist.
- Risk: audit/log retention - legal may need longer retention; confirm costs for extended retention in Console.

Notes-to-self / scribbles:
- If they insist no control-plane telemetry, need fully self-managed control plane deploy (longer lead). Push for minimal telemetry set: anonymized lat/err counts + trace ids.
- Look into adding example of regex-based numeric verifier in solution repo. Link to small script example (seed in git issue).

Next meeting agenda (2025-01-28):
- Confirm VPC peering timeline + KMS approach.
- Show preliminary image build plan and size estimates.
- Walk through evaluation rubric and acceptance criteria.
- Decide pilot window and success thresholds (latency + numeric QC + budget).

Raw timeline estimate to propose in customer deck: 6 weeks to MVP (including legal/NDA & network approvals) but optimistic 3–4 weeks if we get sample data + network approvals quickly.

Misc links / references mentioned on call:
- Redwood Private deployment quick-start (internal): CONFLUENCE-PLT-4827 (shared in chat).
- SE repo: github.com/redwood-inference/windward-proto (ticketed PR #14 for model image build).

End of capture. This is a working doc — expect edits.
